dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct horizontal white bands; a broad, high-contrast band across the median coverts and a narrower, sharp white band across the greater covert tips.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, linear white boundaries are clearly visible along the outer edges of the folded blue-grey secondary and primary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, roughly wedge-shaped white patch is visible on the side of the neck, bordered posteriorly by a distinct black band.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, linear boundary defined by a black transverse band separating the blue-grey crown from the lighter blue-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent black ocular stripe extending from the base of the bill through the eye to the black auricular/nape band.
